notes.title: Learn the tools of the trade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/38324ac98c8e0d8e0f20c1f0117bc7d84064715b.png[/img]

Hey renovators! It’s time to review what tools will be left at your disposal in [b]Airport Renovator[/b]. Those of you who played the demo are likely to know exactly what kind of equipment is available and what each piece is used for. Those who didn’t play the [b]Airport Renovator[/b] demo can utilise this knowledge to become renovation experts in a very short period of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/9c6b295c617a58504206c5b6554e499a93c2c712.png[/img]

The trusty [b]Axe[/b] is your second best companion – considering that the goat is your first. You can use the axe to break padlocks, demolish trash and obviously, chop down trees. It will be very useful in clearing out the area around the runway and clearing the airport out of unwanted scrap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/d840acfed0ebb2851021c188f07fdbdcb3fd03c6.png[/img]

The [b]Dust Blower[/b] is a handy device that can easily clear the runway from sand and dust for a smooth landing and takeoff. It also seems to work like kryptonite for the overly friendly goat. If you need some time alone, just point it at the little bugger and see what happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/b8e35397b8e7cfa5205f656891686133e48c532d.png[/img]

The [b]Pressure Washer[/b] is by far one of the most powerful tools in Airport Renovator. It removes stains and dirt with unimaginable force. Think about a pod of 100 whales blowing out water all at once – it is nothing near to what our [b]Pressure Washer[/b] is capable of. Sadly, it won’t remove blueberry stains from your favourite shirt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/977c2c3a1cb4e1148860f8ebdd000e5ead9dd5ff.png[/img]

[b]Grass Trimmer[/b] does not have an easy life in [b]Airport Renovator[/b]. If you want your airport to look flawless, you’re going to have to use the trimmer very often. It does exactly what you expect – gets rid of all those pesky weeds around the runway, terminal and hangar. There’s nothing like the smell of freshly cut grass in the morning.

notes.title: The Axe - one tool to rule them all
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/14dedc36007a5dc6f60d9f8e342ec13ade52d7b6.png[/img]

You’ve just acquired your first airport, and it’s in a terrible state. The only thing you have in your inventory is an Axe! This most basic of tools will help you out going through the game, and you will find yourself using it for plenty of things. 

[h3]Chop down those trees![/h3]

How many swings do you need to get a tree down? Three, four, or maybe just one power-swing will be enough? Try it out for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/713f0368dbd93d9db8d4978a3f5c3ca4db9863d2.png[/img]

[h3]Get rid of the trash![/h3]

Smash those not-needed pieces of old furniture with your trusty axe. Get rid of all the things you don’t need and make space for new ones!

[h3]Crack those crates open! [/h3]

Once in a while, your friend Amelia sends you an airdrop with a new tool or airport decoration element inside. It comes in a solid wooden box that you need to chop up with nothing else than your trusty axe!

The Hotel Renovator wishlist is now over 40 000 gamers strong, and we want to thank every one of you on that list! It’s not only a massive motivation for us going forward, but it’s also a great indication that we are making games that you guys want to play.

[h3]Halloween Event in Hotel and Airport Renovators![/h3]

This Wednesday (27.10), the Hotel Renovator demo will get a special Halloween update that will make your skin crawl. We don’t want to spoil it for you, so you better launch the game and play it yourself! That’s not all. We are also doing a minor Halloween update for the Airport Renovator demo, so make sure you check this one out too this Wednesday.

That’s right! When we reach sixty thousand wishlists, we are going to give you chickens. How many chickens, you ask? Well, a lot of chickens. You will be able to launch them with a click of a mouse button and see them causing chaos in your beautifully designed Hotel Renovator rooms. They’ll be running around like… headless chickens, only with their heads on ;)

We cannot wait for this crazy gimmick to find its way into the game, so grab your family and friends and ask them to wishlist the game now!

notes.title: The first update for the Airport Renovator demo is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/eac89b387dec0fce567fc88ed995405fa4dcc7c9.png[/img]

You’ve spoken and we’ve listened. [b]The Airport Renovator demo[/b] is really popular and your response to it is simply amazing. You have addressed some things that could be optimized and we’ve figured them out, then we’ve added some of our own and here it is, [b]the first patch[/b] is now live.  


[b]Changelog:[/b]

- Optimized the scene to run much better on slower PC configurations 
- Tweaked the visual settings at all the fidelity levels available from the Graphics Options menu 
- Implemented Nvidia DLSS - can be turned on in the Display Options menu to further boost performance at the cost of slightly reduced visual fidelity 
- Nerfed the goat - doesn't bleat nearly as much and can now be politely told to go away by interacting with it using the "F" key (will come back when asked nicely using the same interaction) 
- Added Goat Volume™ functionality to the Audio Options menu 
- Fixed the "100% complete" achievement not popping up reliably for some players
